title: Optical Tweezers-Assisted siRNA Delivery for Gene Silencing in Plant Protoplasts
content: The traditional nanocarrier-mediated nucleic acid delivery relies on random Brownian diffusion, suffering from slow transport speed and insufficient single-cell targeting ability. In this study, we proposed a targeted siRNA delivery strategy that uses optical tweezers to deliver the siRNA-PS probes to target cells. The nanoscale inter-facial stability and trapping performance of the probes are evaluated. Delivery is achieved in less than 10 s, two orders of magnitude faster than passive-diffusion-based delivery. Using Nicotiana protoplasts as a proof-of-concept cellular model, single siRNA-PS probe target delivery tests achieved a gene-silencing efficiency of up to 92%. This work demonstrates an optical tweezers-driven targeted delivery strategy and provides experimental insights into nanophotonic manipulation of microscale colloidal assemblies.
